senses.gloss:
mfn. sub. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं)
1 Gaping, yawning.
2 Expansion, stretching, expanding.
3 Swelling, a puffing or blowing up.
4 Blowing blossoming.
E.
जृभि to gape, affix घञ्.

m. (-कः)
A subordinate deity.
2 A yawner.
E.
जृभि, and वुन् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Gaping, yawning.
2 Blowing.
E.
जृभि to yawn, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Yawning, gaping.
2 Opening, blowing.
E.
जृभि to open, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Yawning, gaping.
E.
जृम्भा, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-का)
Gaping, yawning.
E.
जृम्भि, and क्वुन् affix, fem. form.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Opened, expanded.
2 Enlarged.
3 Done, exerted.
4 Opened, (as a flower,) blown.
n. (-तं)
1 Gaping, yawning.
2 Swelling, expansion.
3 Bursting, opening.
4 Wish, active wish or search for.
E.
जृभि to gape, affix क्त.

mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि)
1 Who or what yawns or gapes.
2 Expanding, blossoming.
f. (-नी)
A kind of Mimosa, (M. octandra.)
E.
जृम्भ bursting, budding, and इनि aff.
